high_level_description: This image depicts the facade of an old building with a distinct architectural style that appears to be from the early to mid-20th century. The building is painted in a light green color, which has faded over time, giving it a weathered look. The walls show signs of wear and discoloration, indicating age and exposure to the elements. The building features two large windows on the upper floor, each with blue shutters that are closed. Above these windows, there is a decorative element resembling a stylized arch or a small balcony, painted in a darker shade, possibly red or brown.
